title: Fix quantity fields on Sales Return Order Archive
summary: Sales Return Order Archive pages now display return-receipt quantities instead of shipment quantities. Return quantity fields are added and bound to archive records, while shipment fields are hidden by default but remain for extensibility.
key_points: Added Return Qty. to Receive and Return Qty. Received to page 6628, bound to the Sales Line Archive record
Qty. to Ship and Quantity Shipped are hidden by default but kept for page-extension compatibility and personalization
Added test SalesReturnOrderArchiveShowsStoredReturnQuantities to SCM Archive Orders in W1 and ES
No changes to table schema, posting, archive timing or invoiced quantities
quote: The Sales Return Order Archive lines show ordinary shipment quantities instead of return-receipt quantities.
